# AXIKA AI

> AXIKA AI builds Design Autonomy for Dark Factories in Advanced Manufacturing: specialised AI that designs, engineers and validates industrial products on the engineering tools manufacturers already run (CAD, CAE, PLM). Humans set the intent and sign the result.

- Company: AXIKA AI Inc., Delaware C-corporation, San Francisco, founded 2026.
- Founder & CEO: Pina Schlombs — previously built the Industrial AI business at Siemens Digital Industries Software; R&D engineer at Siemens Energy and Volkswagen.
- One line: Design Autonomy for Dark Factories.
- Stage: first paid pilot in execution (2026). Backed by a16z speedrun scouts.
- Contact: hello@axika.ai

## Definitions

- Design Autonomy: AI systems that carry a product from design intent through engineering, validation and certification with humans only at intent and sign-off.
- Dark factory: a production facility that runs with no people on the shop floor; it needs products designed and proven to be built that way.
